official_references.official_effect_text:
2 Level 8 monsters
If this card has a "Photon" card as material, it [b]cannot[/b] be destroyed by card effects. [b]You can[/b] only use each of the following effects of "Number 90: Galaxy-Eyes Photon Lord" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].
● [b]When[/b] an opponent's monster activates its effect ([b]Quick Effect[/b]): [b]You can[/b] detach 1 material from this card; [b]negate[/b] that monster's effect, [b]and[/b] if the detached material was a "Galaxy" card, [b]destroy[/b] that card.
● During your opponent's turn ([b]Quick Effect[/b]): [b]You can[/b] take 1 "Photon" or "Galaxy" card from your Deck, [b]and[/b] either add it to your hand or attach it to this card as material.
